$comment: ADR-0071 D4 — what every colour in the three lists is measured against, and its floor. `apps/web/src/lib/design-system/token-lists-contract.spec.ts` resolves each pair in light, dark and high contrast and fails on any pair under its floor, on any colour without a record, and on an unpaired colour that something uses. Floors: text and grounds 4.5 (WCAG 1.4.3), shapes 3 (WCAG 1.4.11). `exempt` carries the reason a colour has no floor; `unpaired` the reason it has no partner yet.

--color-surface-base.basis: ADR-0059 D6; the page ground carries every text tier

--color-surface-raised.basis: ADR-0059 D6; the card ground carries every text tier

--color-surface-sunken.basis: ADR-0059 D6; the recessed ground carries every text tier

--color-surface-skeleton.exempt: a placeholder ground for content still loading: it carries no text and bounds no control

--color-surface-overlay.exempt: a scrim colour, painted with an opacity where it is used; the text over it is measured with that opacity, against the worst admissible photograph

--color-text-disabled.exempt: WCAG 1.4.3 exempts the text of an inactive component; the dimming is the affordance

--color-text-inverse.unpaired: nothing uses it once both buttons take text.on-brand; the ground it inverts against is recorded at its first use

--color-text-on-brand.basis: ADR-0059; `colors.dark.json`: filled brand and semantic grounds keep their colour in every theme, so the text on them does not invert

--color-border-strong.basis: ADR-0066 D1; the edge of an object

--color-border-default.exempt: a rule between things that are not objects, never an object's edge

--color-border-subtle.exempt: a row rule inside a dense table, never an object's edge

--color-field-surface.basis: ADR-0097; the resting ground of a form control. It carries the value (--color-text-primary, `forms.css` .field-control) and the label, the placeholder and the select chevron (--color-text-secondary, `forms.css` .field-label and ::placeholder, `select-field.tsx`). NOT --color-text-muted: nothing paints it inside a field, and --color-text-disabled is exempt at its own record. The EDGES read against this ground are measured at their own shape records - field.border, semantic.error, action.default and the focus ring - because a shape floor is 3 and a ground record carries 4.5

--color-field-surface-focus.basis: ADR-0097; the same ground while the field holds focus (`forms.css` .field:focus-within), carrying the same two text tiers

--color-field-border.basis: ADR-0097; WCAG 1.4.11 - the visual boundary of a user-interface component, read against the field it encloses in both of its states and against the card the field sits on. In dark the field ground equals the card ground, so this edge is the only thing giving the field a shape

--color-focus-offset.basis: ADR-0051; the halo is read against the ring beside it

--a11y-focus-ring.basis: ADR-0051; ADR-0097 adds the two field grounds - `interactive.ts` FIELD_EDGE rings a focused field

--button-primary-text.basis: ADR-0071 D1; measured at rest, on hover and pressed

--button-danger-text.basis: ADR-0071 D2; measured at rest, on hover and pressed

--button-disabled-background.exempt: WCAG 1.4.3 exempts an inactive component; opacity, cursor and aria-disabled carry the state with the colour

--card-border.exempt: the outline of a card that is not a control: WCAG 1.4.11 requires 3:1 of a control's boundary. The site's cards draw their edge in border.strong (ADR-0066 D1); the dashboard's uses of this token are a FOLLOW-UP in ADR-0071

--color-section-green-divider.exempt: a decorative rule, never a control boundary

--color-section-red-divider.exempt: a decorative rule, never a control boundary

--color-section-black-divider.exempt: a decorative rule, never a control boundary

--color-section-adjacent-separator.basis: ADR-0059 D2; the band between a green and a red section

--color-semantic-success.basis: ADR-0051; an icon or an edge

--color-semantic-success-text.basis: ADR-0071 D1; the state as text

--color-semantic-error.basis: ADR-0051; an icon or an edge; ADR-0097 adds the two field grounds - the invalid edge (`contact-form.tsx` CONTROL_INVALID, `interactive.ts` FIELD_CONTROL and FIELD_TEXTAREA) is read against the field it encloses, not against the card behind it

--color-semantic-error-text.basis: ADR-0071 D1; closes ADR-0067's DESIGN SYSTEM GAP semantic.error-text

--color-semantic-warning.basis: ADR-0051; ADR-0071 D1 corrects the light value

--color-semantic-warning-text.basis: ADR-0071 D1; the state as text

--color-semantic-info.basis: ADR-0051; an icon or an edge

--color-semantic-info-text.basis: ADR-0071 D1; the state as text

--color-semantic-neutral.unpaired: nothing uses it; the light value measures 2.47:1 on surface.sunken, so its first use needs a pairing and a step that clears 3:1

--color-semantic-medal-gold.unpaired: nothing uses the flat value; ADR-0065 D2 measures the medal families as tints (700 on 50, 300 on the dark page), recorded at first use

--color-semantic-medal-silver.unpaired: nothing uses the flat value; ADR-0065 D2 measures the medal families as tints, recorded at first use

--color-semantic-medal-bronze.unpaired: nothing uses the flat value; ADR-0065 D2 measures the medal families as tints, recorded at first use

--color-item-1-surface.basis: ADR-0072 D1; an item card carries its title, its description and its ink on this ground, never the muted tier

--color-item-1-ink.basis: ADR-0072 D1; the number is text on its card, and the statement ordinals set the ink on the page grounds

--color-item-1-edge.exempt: an item card is not a control, so WCAG 1.4.11 asks nothing of its boundary, and light draws no edge (the card's own ground). Dark draws the ramp's 200 step, held at 3:1 or more on the page grounds and the green register by the item-colour part of token-lists-contract.spec.ts; high contrast draws it black at that theme's border width

--color-item-2-surface.basis: ADR-0072 D1; an item card carries its title, its description and its ink on this ground, never the muted tier

--color-item-2-ink.basis: ADR-0072 D1; the number is text on its card, and the statement ordinals set the ink on the page grounds

--color-item-2-edge.exempt: an item card is not a control, so WCAG 1.4.11 asks nothing of its boundary, and light draws no edge (the card's own ground). Dark draws the ramp's 200 step, held at 3:1 or more on the page grounds and the green register by the item-colour part of token-lists-contract.spec.ts; high contrast draws it black at that theme's border width

--color-item-3-ink.basis: ADR-0072 D1; the number is text on its card, and the statement ordinals set the ink on the page grounds

--color-item-3-edge.exempt: an item card is not a control, so WCAG 1.4.11 asks nothing of its boundary, and light draws no edge (the card's own ground). Dark draws the ramp's 200 step, held at 3:1 or more on the page grounds and the green register by the item-colour part of token-lists-contract.spec.ts; high contrast draws it black at that theme's border width

--color-item-4-surface.basis: ADR-0072 D1; an item card carries its title, its description and its ink on this ground, never the muted tier

--color-item-4-ink.basis: ADR-0072 D1; the number is text on its card, and the statement ordinals set the ink on the page grounds

--color-item-4-edge.exempt: an item card is not a control, so WCAG 1.4.11 asks nothing of its boundary, and light draws no edge (the card's own ground). Dark draws the ramp's 200 step, held at 3:1 or more on the page grounds and the green register by the item-colour part of token-lists-contract.spec.ts; high contrast draws it black at that theme's border width

--color-topic-training-surface.basis: ADR-0094 D2; the topic chip carries only its own label

--color-topic-training-ink.basis: ADR-0094 D2; the label on its own chip, never on the page

--color-topic-training-edge.exempt: a topic chip is a label, not a control, so WCAG 1.4.11 asks nothing of its boundary: light and dark draw none (the chip's own ground), and high contrast draws it black

--color-topic-youth-surface.basis: ADR-0094 D2; the topic chip carries only its own label

--color-topic-youth-ink.basis: ADR-0094 D2; the label on its own chip, never on the page

--color-topic-youth-edge.exempt: a topic chip is a label, not a control, so WCAG 1.4.11 asks nothing of its boundary: light and dark draw none (the chip's own ground), and high contrast draws it black

--color-topic-international-surface.basis: ADR-0094 D2; the topic chip carries only its own label

--color-topic-international-ink.basis: ADR-0094 D2; the label on its own chip, never on the page

--color-topic-international-edge.exempt: a topic chip is a label, not a control, so WCAG 1.4.11 asks nothing of its boundary: light and dark draw none (the chip's own ground), and high contrast draws it black

--color-topic-community-surface.basis: ADR-0094 D2; the topic chip carries only its own label

--color-topic-community-ink.basis: ADR-0094 D2; the label on its own chip, never on the page

--color-topic-community-edge.exempt: a topic chip is a label, not a control, so WCAG 1.4.11 asks nothing of its boundary: light and dark draw none (the chip's own ground), and high contrast draws it black

--color-topic-records-surface.basis: ADR-0094 D2; the topic chip carries only its own label

--color-topic-records-ink.basis: ADR-0094 D2; the label on its own chip, never on the page

--color-topic-records-edge.exempt: a topic chip is a label, not a control, so WCAG 1.4.11 asks nothing of its boundary: light and dark draw none (the chip's own ground), and high contrast draws it black

--color-topic-national-team-surface.basis: ADR-0094 D2; the topic chip carries only its own label

--color-topic-national-team-ink.basis: ADR-0094 D2; the label on its own chip, never on the page

--color-topic-national-team-edge.exempt: a topic chip is a label, not a control, so WCAG 1.4.11 asks nothing of its boundary: light and dark draw none (the chip's own ground), and high contrast draws it black

--color-border-accent.basis: ADR-0072 D3; the accent rule is a non-text mark on the page grounds (WCAG 1.4.11)

--color-action-default.basis: ADR-0072 D13; the Action role as an edge or a glyph on the page grounds (WCAG 1.4.11); as a fill it carries --color-text-on-brand, recorded there; ADR-0097 adds the two field grounds - `surface.ts` FIELD_EDGE takes this colour on hover, active and focus. --color-brand-primary, which `interactive.ts` FIELD_EDGE uses for those same three states, is declared once in base.css and so carries no record of its own here; it is #00843D in all three themes, the same value as this token, so this row measures it too

--color-accent-live.basis: ADR-0088 D1; the live accent as ink on the page grounds. Measured lowest: light 6.67:1 (sunken), dark 4.86:1 (raised), high contrast 7.33:1. It is not a partner of the coloured registers: on the green, red and black bands it measures 1.11 to 2.86:1 and is not drawn there

--color-accent-track.basis: ADR-0088 D2; the track mark on the black register: light 17.45:1, dark 7.51:1 on the warm black that list uses, high contrast 21:1 as white. Over the hero's wash it is measured where it is used, against the worst admissible photograph, as --color-surface-overlay is. On the green and red bands it measures 7.81 and 6.77:1 in light and dark, but those bands are white in high contrast, where this is white too: they are not partners until a use there draws its high-contrast mark in the band's own ink

--color-logo-pinned-edge.basis: ADR-0086 D3; the edge that marks the one pinned sponsorship in the strip, on the black register. Measured 8.84:1 in light (#D4A017 on #000000), 4.90:1 in dark (#E9B836 on #4A4942) and 21:1 in high contrast (#FFFFFF on #000000). Deliberately not --color-semantic-medal-gold: gold is the medal reference (TDR-002) and a pinned sponsor is a commercial arrangement rather than an achievement, and that token measures 2.45:1 on this register in high contrast. Never colour alone — the edge is drawn at --border-width-thick where every other item carries the default, and the tier line names the sponsorship in words (WCAG 1.4.1)

--color-logo-plate.basis: ADR-0085 D6.1; the plate behind a sponsor, partner or membership mark stands bare on the black register (the strip and the banner) and, inside a card, on the green register (partners), where it reads as its own object (WCAG 1.4.11)
--color-logo-plate.exempt: ADR-0085 D8 #3: one number cannot state this boundary, because what bounds the plate changes with the list. Light and dark: its own #FFFFFF fill, on #000000 and #4A4942 and on #005226. High contrast: the green register is #FFFFFF there and the fill measures 1:1, so every plate draws --color-border-strong (#000000, 21:1 against white on both sides) at --border-width-default, in that list and in forced-colors only; the black register stays #000000 and keeps its fill boundary. All four measurements are made in the logo-plate part of token-lists-contract.spec.ts

--color-map-marker.basis: ADR-0072 D13; the location pin is a meaningful non-text mark (WCAG 1.4.11), drawn under its label card on the base ground and over map imagery, which is not a theme colour

--color-brand-surface-green-from.basis: ADR-0098 §8.2 - the gradient's LIGHTEST stop, which is the point that has to pass: a gradient's contrast is its lightest point. Pantone 348C, 4.81:1 with white. Both text partners resolve to the same white on purpose - 0.31 above the floor is one tier's headroom and no more, so hierarchy on this ground is size and weight

--color-brand-surface-green-to.basis: ADR-0098 §8.2 - the dark stop, recorded as well as the light one so that moving either end is measured rather than assumed

--color-brand-surface-green-text-muted.basis: ADR-0098 §8.2 - the same white as the tier above it, and that is the decision rather than an oversight. `brand-surface-contract.spec.ts` fails if it ever resolves to anything else

--color-brand-surface-green-border.basis: ADR-0098 §8.2; WCAG 1.4.11 - a card edge on this ground

--color-brand-surface-green-divider.exempt: a rule between things that are not objects, never an object's edge - the same treatment --color-border-default has

--color-brand-surface-red-from.basis: ADR-0098 §8.2 - the lightest stop. Pantone 186C, 5.88:1 with white

--color-brand-surface-red-text-muted.basis: ADR-0098 §8.2 - the same white as the tier above it, by decision

--color-brand-surface-red-divider.exempt: a rule between things that are not objects

--color-brand-surface-ink-surface.basis: ADR-0098 §8.4 - #0B0B0B, fixed in every theme by owner decision. 19.68:1 and 10.34:1 with its two tiers. It measures 1.05:1 against the dark page ground, which is why every ink surface carries a non-surface edge cue; that rule lives in `surface-adjacency-contract.spec.ts` rather than here, because it is about composition and not about a pair of colours

--color-brand-surface-ink-text-muted.basis: ADR-0098 §8.4 - ink is dark enough to carry a real second tier, unlike the two gradients

--color-brand-surface-ink-accent.basis: ADR-0098 §8c - the green ink tier on ink, for a label that is green because it is a category and not because it is a link. green.300 measures 6.90:1 against #0B0B0B in the light and dark lists; high contrast carries no hue here and takes white at 19.68:1. The kit green (green.500) is 4.09:1 on this ground and is a plate, not an ink - which is what this row exists to stop anyone re-deciding

--color-brand-surface-ink-divider.exempt: a rule between things that are not objects

--color-tricolor-mid.basis: ADR-0098 D3 - the step that separates green from red inside the tricolour ramp: black on a light ground, white on a dark one
--color-tricolor-mid.exempt: not a boundary a reader has to find and not text: it is the separation between two stops of one gradient. Its real floor is perceptual - visibly different from both neighbours AND from the ground it sits on - and that is measured in `brand-surface-contract.spec.ts`, which checks it against green, against red and against every surface, in all three themes
